about:
White Space operates from Reno, Nevada, and has spent two decades turning high-stakes hospitality visions into reality. The company has delivered projects for brands such as Ritz‑Carlton, Disney, Kate Spade, Soho House, and Outrigger across locations from New York to Tel Aviv, California to Hawaii.

The firm manages the global manufacturing of custom interiors for hospitality and commercial spaces. Its services span procurement, factory‑matched production, on‑site quality control, custom furniture design, millwork, stone and glass fabrication, and full installation. White Space reports 600‑plus furniture designs completed and a 99 % customer satisfaction rate, with a team of project and QC managers overseeing production at partner factories worldwide.

Clients come from the hospitality, gaming, luxury resort, and restaurant sectors. Concrete examples include the Cosmopolitan Las Vegas, Hyatt Miraval, the George, and Soho House Jaffa. The company also serves commercial developers and architects seeking turnkey interior execution.

White Space differentiates itself by building a purpose‑built supply chain for each project, providing US‑based project management with boots‑on‑the‑ground quality teams at every factory. The company emphasizes masterful millwork and complex architectural woodwork as core expertise, and promises standards without borders through direct oversight of production and logistics.
